summary: This segment is a design recommendation (no edits made) proposing an internal vocabulary refactor that renames `activeDomains`/`domainId`/`domains` to `enabledExtensionIds`/`integrations`/`availableExtensions` while keeping the existing protocol v25 wire shape via deprecated aliases and a single server-side `sessionIntegrations` normalizer.
decisions: Treat the change as an internal vocabulary refactor with explicit protocol adapters rather than a protocol-version bump, because v25 schemas use `additionalProperties: false` and adding new wire fields would break existing clients.

Rename `activeDomains` → `enabledExtensionIds`; rename singular legacy `domainId` → canonical `integrations`; rename runtime aggregate `activeDomains` → `activeExtensions`; keep `project.detect` wire field `domains` but map internally to `availableExtensions`.

Reuse one `workspaceIntegrationSchema` in both `sessionOptionsSchema` and `agentSessionSummarySchema` and keep `workspaceProfileExtensionSchema` as a deprecated alias to avoid TypeScript API breakage.

Introduce a single protocol normalizer `sessionIntegrations({integrations, domainId})` with these semantics: explicit `integrations: []` wins over `domainId`; `domainId: 'generic'` becomes `[]`; neither field returns `undefined` (server uses workspace defaults). This is the only server location that interprets `domainId`.

Preserve temporary compatibility surfaces on the wire: keep accepting `session.create.options.domainId`, keep parsing `AgentSessionSummary.domainId`, keep emitting/parsing `session.created.domains` (v25 wire name for enabled extension IDs), keep `project.detect.result.domains` / `ProjectDomains` wire shape, and keep tolerating legacy `projects.json` `domainId` entries. Do not send `domainId` from current app code.
At the project-detection boundary, expose `availableExtensions` and `config` internally; do not rename the wire `ProjectDomains.domains` field, and translate only at the request-handler boundary.
Update tests to cover legacy `domainId` normalization, `integrations`/`generic`/absent-field precedence, wire `domains` still parsing, and that current app code sends `integrations` never `domainId`.
